title: AuditRequest
description: The JSON body a buyer POSTs to an audit merchant, czar-audit-quick or czar-audit-deep (SCR-182 §2).

contract.description: Solidity source text, or a 0x-prefixed 40-hex contract address when the merchant's address lookup is on; at most merchants.audit.maxInputChars (2000) characters (SCR-182 §2, §6).
